title: fix(app-shell): a flow screen select with no placeholder reads the locale's common.select (objectui#11220)
body:
Fixes #11220
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A flow screen field of select shape (it carries `options`) with no `placeholder` fell back to a hard-coded English `'Select…'` in `ScreenFieldInput`. Both surfaces that render a screen go through `ScreenView`: the runtime `FlowRunner` dialog and Studio's flow screen preview (`ScreenPreview`, since PR objectui#11219). So the named producer (objectstack `examples/app-todo`, `screen_1`'s `category`: a `type: 'select'` with `options`, no `placeholder`, no `defaultValue`) read "Select…" under every locale.

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx`, `ScreenFieldInput` only: the fallback is now `field.placeholder ?? t('common.select', { defaultValue: 'Select…' })`, with `t` from `useObjectTranslation()` in `@object-ui/i18n`. `@object-ui/app-shell` already declares that dependency. No new key, no new literal list: `common.select` ships in all ten built-in packs. It is also the word the object form's own lookup picker (`LookupField`) already shows in this spot, including on this screen's own `lookup` arm.
- `||` becomes `??`, per the triage grade. An authored `placeholder: ''` now renders as authored, empty. An authored placeholder still renders verbatim.
- The local that held the lowercased field type was called `t`. It is renamed `kind`, so the translator binds as `t`. `check:i18n-keys` classifies call sites by a binding named `t`. The ablation below shows the gate now reads this call site.
- Pin: `packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.selectPlaceholderLocale-11220.test.tsx`, beside the existing `ScreenView.*.test.tsx` suites. It asserts the key's identity, not its copy: the trigger shows what the bound instance answers for `common.select`.
- `.changeset/11220-screen-select-placeholder-i18n.md`: a patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`, with the user-facing sentence.

Out of scope, per the claim: `ScreenView`'s other English defaults, and the flow designer inspectors (objectui#10948, seat 2).

## Why `common.select` and not `common.selectOption`

The object form uses two words:
- its select widget (`SelectField`) reads `common.selectOption`, which is "Select an option" in en;
- its lookup picker reads `common.select`, which is "Select…".

The grade asked for the object form's existing "select…" key. `common.select` is that key. It keeps the en bytes identical to what shipped, and it matches the word this same screen already shows on its `lookup` arm.

## Measurements (the PM's mechanism assumptions)

1. **"The i18n path `ScreenView` already uses" did not exist.** At base `b32e7debc8`, `ScreenView.tsx` imported nothing from `@object-ui/i18n` (read from its import block). This confirms the PM's reading. Its sibling views use `useObjectTranslation()`: `ActionParamDialog` and `ActionConfirmDialog` import it from `@object-ui/i18n`, and `FlowRunner` uses the `@object-ui/react` re-export.
   - `ScreenView`'s other English strings (`'Save & Continue'`, `'Cancel'`, the no-data-source line) are callee defaults, and both in-repo callers override them. `FlowRunner` passes translated `submitText` and `cancelText` (`flowRunner.saveAndContinue`, `common.cancel` / `common.close`). `ScreenPreview` hides the bar and passes a translated `noDataSourceMessage`.
   - All three `FlowRunner` mounts pass a `dataSource`: `FlowRunsPage`, `useConsoleActionRuntime` and `RecordDetailView`.
2. **Every built-in locale carries `common.select`.** All ten packs define it under `common` (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh). `packages/i18n` pins it per language in its tests `i18n.test.ts` and `common-search-retired-4392.test.ts`. No pack edit was needed.
3. **No provider change is needed.** With no `I18nProvider`, the hook answers the call's inline en default. Without that default it answers the raw key `common.select`: the ablation below turns the provider-less pin red.
   - Studio's designer locale is `useMetadataLocale()`, which derives from `useObjectTranslation().language`. So the preview's fallback follows the designer's language.
4. **`ConfigFieldRenderer`'s select fallback in `@object-ui/components` stays.** It is measured as not user-facing in this tree.
   - Its only in-repo producers are plugin-dashboard's `DashboardConfigPanel` (`refreshIntervalSeconds`, `theme`) and `WidgetConfigPanel` (`type`, `colorVariant`).
   - A throwaway runtime probe, not committed, rendered every select field those schema builders emit, with the value unset. Each trigger drew its `defaultValue` option's label, never the placeholder. The probe's positive control, a select with no default, drew "Select…", so the probe could see a placeholder.
   - Those panels are mounted only by `DashboardWithConfig`, which no app or view in this tree mounts. `ConfigPanelRenderer` is not a registered SDUI node, so no metadata author reaches it either.
   - This falsifies part of the PM's assumption: `@object-ui/components` already declares `@object-ui/i18n`, and its sibling `config-panel-renderer.tsx` already translates its footer through `createSafeTranslation`. A later fix would need no new dependency edge and no new prop.
5. **Hard-coded `Select…` placeholders in product source**, excluding tests, comments and translation tables: four sites.
   - `ScreenView`: fixed here.
   - `ConfigFieldRenderer`: see 4.
   - `DatasourceResourcePage`'s enum select, left alone per the order because PR objectui#11241 touches `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`.
   - The console settings page's `SettingsField` closed select. See the acceptance notes.

## Tests

Measured on this branch's head (the full list of commands and verdict lines is in the dev report on the card):

- **Red first**, pin against the unmodified base source: `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`.
  - Under zh, the trigger showed `Select…` where the zh pack's word was expected.
  - The authored `''` was replaced by `Select…`.
- **Green**, pin plus the two sibling `ScreenView` suites: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 22 passed (22)`.
- **Ablations**, each through `ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor was hit, the mutation was on disk (blob moved), and the file was restored to `blob == HEAD` with `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - `??` back to `||`: only "an authored empty placeholder stays empty" goes red (`1 failed | 4 passed`).
  - Dropping the inline `defaultValue`: only "with no I18nProvider, the fallback is the en word, never the raw key" goes red (`1 failed | 4 passed`).
  - Changing the inline default to other text: `check:i18n-keys` exits 1 with `[default-value-drift] common.select` on `ScreenView.tsx`. The gate reads this call site.
- Build and type-check: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (29 packages) passed, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exited 0. That runs `tsc --noEmit` plus `tsconfig.test.json`, which compiles the pin.
- The `packages/app-shell/src/views/` suite results are in the dev report on the card.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:control-bytes`, and `check-changeset-presence` (1 changeset for 1 released package).

## Acceptance notes

These were observed and not filed. None has a measured public door or a named producer that reaches the string. No carrier is known for any of them (承接者：无).

- `ScreenView`'s `'Save & Continue'` / `'Cancel'` / no-data-source defaults: every in-repo caller overrides or hides them (measurement 1).
- `ConfigFieldRenderer`'s select `'Select…'` fallback: not reached by any in-repo producer (measurement 4). If a producer without a `defaultValue` appears, the route is the package's existing `createSafeTranslation` table with `common.select`.
- `DatasourceResourcePage`'s enum select placeholder `Select…`: that page carries other English copy as well (its sync toasts, for example), so this is a page-level family, not a one-word defect. Studio's own table already has `engine.form.selectEllipsis`. Reach was not measured.
- `SettingsField`'s closed select placeholder `Select…` (console settings). The objectstack settings manifests were read at `157baa75f2`. Every `type: 'select'` there that renders the closed dropdown declares a `default`, and the one without a default (`localization.currency`) declares `valueDomain`, so it renders the combobox arm instead.
